svg.title: Battery used per hour with the lid closed: about 7% for semi-stock software standby and about 2% for slot.advance 1.0.0 hardware sleep
svg.desc: Two horizontal bars from battery-gauge readings. Semi-stock standby: slot.advance 0.3.0, a modified build held in software standby with the screen off, went from 61% to 47% in 2 hours, about 7% an hour (ordinary 0.3.0 shuts down 3 minutes after the lid closes). slot.advance 1.0.0, hardware sleep (suspend-to-RAM): about 2% an hour. 1.0.0 keeps 0.5.0's hardware sleep unchanged, and the figure comes from two extended 8-hour sleeps on a 0.5.0 test build: 77% to 61% with Wi-Fi off and 80% to 64% with Wi-Fi on, both 2% an hour. Observed gauge readings in whole percent, not guaranteed battery life.

g.text: Battery used per hour, lid closed
As shown by the battery gauge, in whole percent
1.0.0 uses the same hardware sleep as 0.5.0. Its figure comes from two
extended 8-hour sleeps measured on 0.5.0, one with Wi-Fi off, one with it on.
Semi-stock: 0.3.0 held in software standby (61% to 47% in 2 hours).
Observed gauge readings, not guaranteed battery life.
